author: Mathew Beall
releaseNotes:
v2.0.0: The integration is now an app. After installing, go to Apps > Add User App > X-Sense Integration, enter your X-Sense email and password, and click Done. Devices are created automatically.

Upgrading from 1.x: set up the app, re-point rules and HSM at the new child devices, then delete the old 'X-Sense Bridge' virtual device (this removes its children). The old bridge driver is kept as an optional, deprecated component and will be removed in a later release.

Also includes 1.1.x changes: water leak sensor (SWS51) support, driver chosen by device type, Recreate Child Devices action, raw shadow logging option.
